whatIs.title: What it is and what it is not
whatIs.subtitle: You talk to it through Claude, the AI assistant, on your computer. Like a coworker who has read everything.
is: Your company's memory: how things are done, the criteria, the reference data and where each document is.
It answers with what your documents say and tells you which one it comes from.
It does tasks: if one is written down step by step, the assistant follows it for you. If it does not know how, you teach it once and it remembers.
It lives on your computers, not on the internet. It is yours.
isNot: It is not an internet search engine: if something is not in your brain, it tells you.
It is not a file store: your PDF, Excel and Word files stay where they are.
It is not a program you have to learn: there are no menus, you talk and it answers.
It does not replace your accountant, your safety officer or your lawyer. It saves you searching and repeating.

messages.text: Which varnish do we use for exterior doors?
For exterior we use a water-based varnish with UV filter: two coats, with a light sanding between them. We buy it from Levante Varnishes, who deliver in 48 hours.
messages.source: Source: Finishes and varnishes · reviewed on 12 Sep

messages.text: Prepare the quote for the kitchen of the customer on Main Street.

I am following the procedure “How to prepare a quote”. With the measurements you took on Tuesday it comes to 3.20 linear metres with an island, oak worktop and soft-close hinges. Shall I make it a PDF with your logo?
Done: quote-main-street.pdf, in the task folder.
messages.source: Procedure: How to prepare a quote

messages.text: We now buy the exterior varnish from Turia Timber.
I will change one document, “Finishes and varnishes”: the exterior varnish supplier becomes Turia Timber. The previous version stays in the history. Shall I confirm?
Done. From now on the brain only says what is true today.

features.title: Everything it can do
features.subtitle: What it knows depends on what your company teaches it. This is what it does with that.

items.title: Answers from your documents
items.text: Ask in your own words and it answers, citing the document it comes from. If it does not know, it says so and notes the question.

items.title: Does tasks step by step
items.text: Quotes, work reports, entries in your spreadsheets. It follows the procedure the same way every time, with the permissions you approve.

items.title: Learns new tasks
items.text: Explain something that repeats and it proposes it in writing. Once you approve it, it stays in the brain.

items.title: Uses what you already have
items.text: It reads your usual folders (PDF, Word, Excel, emails, scans) without you tidying anything. Your originals are never touched.

items.title: PDFs with your logo
items.text: Quotes, work reports and order sheets with your company's look, filled in with your data.

items.title: Connects your software
items.text: If part of the work lives in another program, it uses it through verified connectors. It first tries without connecting anything.

items.title: Password vault
items.text: Passwords live encrypted on your computer. The assistant never sees them.

items.title: Automatic backups
items.text: Every week, verified, to the drive or folder you choose. The last four are kept.

items.title: From your phone too
items.text: Use it from your phone or another computer, with Claude, while the computer it lives on is on and Claude is open.

items.title: Health report
items.text: Every month it tells you what has not been reviewed and, above all, which questions it could not answer: what is left to document.

different.title: Built for companies that are not in IT

items.text: An extension for Claude Desktop on Mac and Windows. A double click, three questions and a few windows to accept.

items.title: Your data, on your machines
items.text: The brain and your documents live on your computers. We never receive your brain or your passwords. Under GDPR, that matters.

items.title: Speaks your language
items.text: Set up in English or Spanish, and each person can ask in their own language: the assistant answers in the language of the conversation.

items.title: For the whole team
items.text: Up to 10 people on the same brain, with locked areas: Production sees how Health & Safety works, not its data.

items.title: Nothing behind your back
items.text: Before changing anything it shows you what it will do and waits for your “yes”. Health information it does not even open.

items.title: Yours for good
items.text: Perpetual license: if you drop the monthly plan, you lose support, not the use.

promise.title: Your information is yours
promise.quote: Your information is yours. Your brain lives on your computers and procedures run on them. When the assistant needs something, it looks up only what it needs, answers you and that is it: it is not used to train any model and it does not stay in Claude's memory. The only thing left is your conversation, in your Claude account, and you delete it whenever you want. To make it so, during setup we show you how to turn off Claude's training and memory; with Claude Team, training is off by contract and memory comes off by default.

howItWorks.title: Everything it does, without jargon
howItWorks.subtitle: The Digital Brain is your company's memory, organized and always at hand. You talk to it through Claude and it also does tasks for you.

talk.title: How to talk to it
talk.askText: Ask in your own words, the way you would say it in the workshop or at the office. It answers and tells you which document it comes from.
askExamples: Which papers does the accountant need to register a freelancer?
How often is the workshop lift inspected?
What do we do if a customer disputes an invoice?
How do we close the till at the end of the day?
talk.doText: If the task is already in the brain, it follows it step by step. If not, it offers to learn it.
doExamples: Prepare the quote for a kitchen for this customer.
Add today's order to the orders spreadsheet.
The compressor service is now every six months.
Organize the office folders according to the standards.

permissions.title: It asks before it acts
permissions.subtitle: The brain changes nothing behind your back. It asks in three ways:

items.title: It shows you what it will do
items.text: Before changing or adding anything, it tells you in plain words what will change. You confirm once and it does it in one go.

items.title: It opens a window for you to choose
items.text: When it needs one of your folders or files, a window opens for you to pick it. It never asks you to type where something is.

items.title: It asks you to approve permissions
items.text: The first time a task needs to touch something on your computer, a window says in normal words what it will be able to do. Risky items are flagged and reject is the default button.

items.title: Find answers
items.text: It searches everything it knows and tells you where it got it from. It also answers about a document's history: what changed, who and why.

items.title: Do tasks and learn new ones
items.text: It follows written procedures the same way every time. If something repeats, explain it, it proposes it in writing and, once you approve it, it learns it.

items.title: Change what it knows
items.text: A new supplier, a different price: tell it. It shows you the change before making it and the previous version stays in the history.

items.title: Take in your company's documents
items.text: You choose the folder, it proposes the areas it sees and writes their documents. It reads PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, emails, scans and photos. It does not make one document per file: 400 quotes become a summary and an inventory.

items.title: Organize your folders
items.text: It proposes an order based on your industry's standards and makes an organized copy. Sensitive files go to a separate folder it does not open.

items.title: Find the original
items.text: It does not store your files, but it knows where each one is: it tells you the folder and the name.

items.title: PDFs with your logo
items.text: Set it up once with your template or logo, and the documents you make over and over come out with your look.

items.title: Connect software you already use
items.text: It first tries with your files. If needed, it uses verified connectors and you decide what it can do alone and what it asks you first.

items.title: Password vault
items.text: Encrypted and opened with your master password. Tasks take what they need from it; the assistant never sees them.

items.title: Several people and locked areas
items.text: With a team, up to 10 people. Add and remove people with a sentence, and locked areas are only seen by whoever you say.

items.title: Backups
items.text: They run by themselves every week, are verified and the last four are kept. If one fails, it tells you.

items.title: From your phone and in other languages
items.text: Use it from your phone with Claude. It is set up in English or Spanish, and each person can ask in their own language.

never.title: What it never does
never.subtitle: The underlying rule: the brain keeps the know-how, not the sensitive data.

items.title: Health
items.text: It never opens medical check-ups, medical reports or sick leave, and never writes a person next to an illness in any document.

items.title: Passwords
items.text: It does not open files that look like passwords. If it finds one written down, it does not copy it: it warns you. It never asks for one in the conversation.

items.title: Personal data
items.text: Payslips, contracts or IDs are only opened if you allow it for that folder, and even then without writing people's names.

items.title: Your originals
items.text: They are never modified. Nothing is installed or connected without your permission, and nothing moves from one brain to another without your “yes”.

security.title: Your data, on your computers
security.subtitle: What happens to your information when you use the Digital Brain, and how to report a security flaw to us.
behind: The brain's content and the passwords live on your computers. Pymatic Labs does not receive them.
What the assistant reads travels to Anthropic, the company behind Claude, and stays in your Claude history until you delete it.
With Claude Team or Enterprise, Anthropic does not train on that data, by contract, and Claude's memory comes off.
With Claude Pro or Max, memory comes on and training is decided in Claude's privacy settings. That is why during setup we show you how to turn both off.
security.behindNote: Setup cannot check those Claude settings: it shows you how to set them. Anthropic also sets two exceptions: response ratings you send it and whatever its safety filters flag.
also: Your originals are never modified: the brain only reads them.
Nothing is installed or connected without your permission.
The license is checked on your computer, offline: there is no remote kill switch.
Updates are only accepted if they are signed by Pymatic Labs.
Security fixes are free during your version's support period, with or without a monthly plan.
